query: Share the latest release date and core features of Python 3.13, specifically mentioning free-threaded mode (no-GIL) and the new JIT compiler.
trusted_context: Python 3.13 is released in October 2024 (official release date October 7, 2024). Major features include experimental free-threaded CPython (PEP 703 without GIL) and an experimental copy-and-patch basic JIT compiler.
search_query: Python 3.13 release date free-threaded JIT features
ground_truth_reference:
Python 3.13 is officially here! 🎉 Highlights:
• Experimental free-threaded mode (no GIL)
• Experimental JIT compiler
• Improved error messages & interactive shell

A huge leap forward for Python performance!

query: Summarize the architecture details of DeepSeek-V3 based on its technical report, specifically mentioning total parameters (671B), active parameters per token (37B), and Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA).
trusted_context: DeepSeek-V3 is an open-weights Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 671B total parameters and 37B activated parameters per token. It employs Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) and DeepSeekMoE architectures.
ground_truth_reference:
DeepSeek-V3 architecture breakdown:
• 671B total parameters (37B active per token)
• Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) for inference efficiency
• Multi-token prediction training objective

Open weights pushing the boundaries of MoE efficiency.
